messages:
Maria: Quick sync — Novablue customer story. They saw a clear cost/latency win and are open to a short testimonial video + 2-paragraph case study. Need to coordinate interview, get a quote cleared by legal, and lock an embargo date (target launch 2026-04-07). Who can own logistics + draft quote?
Sam: I can draft the quote and 2-paragraph writeup. Will need the exact numbers and a couple soundbites.
Ava: I can handle recording logistics (remote). Wed/Thu mornings PT are best for me.
Jordan: Sales checked with the customer — they prefer Wed morning. I can confirm 10am PT.
Maria: @Linda could you pre-check typical quote language? We want to avoid legal back-and-forth during the recording.
Linda: Sure — send the draft. Heads up: we need explicit consent for video + a usage line. Also prefer approx symbols (~) unless they give exact numbers backed by a report.
Sam: Draft quote: "Novablue reduced inference costs by 21% and cut tail latency by 35% after moving to Redwood Dedicated." Thoughts? @Linda
Linda: Two quick asks: 1) change to approximate phrasing (e.g., ~20%) or attach the benchmark data, 2) include an explicit consent sentence we can read on recording.
Alex: Product will produce the benchmark deck and the small runbook for the case study. Uploading to Drive now: https://drive.redwood/novablue-bench (will add raw numbers and legend).
Sam: Interview script draft:
```
1) Can you describe the before/after scenario?
2) Which metric moved the most for you (cost, latency, etc.)?
3) Any specific configuration or tip you wish you knew before migrating?
4) Short closing sentence for a 1-line quote.
```
Ava: Recording checklist: Zoom link + local backup, brief intro script, 2-minute test at the top, and the consent line read aloud. I'll create the calendar invite once @Jordan confirms time.
Jordan: Confirmed with Novablue — Wed 10am PT. Sending calendar invite + recording waiver form now.
Sam: Updating the quote to: "Novablue saw ~20% reduction in inference costs and ~35% lower tail latency after adopting Redwood Dedicated." Sharing updated draft in a sec.
Linda: That phrasing looks fine. I'll mark it approved pending the signed consent in the waiver form. Please capture the waiver on recording.
Maria: Awesome — putting this on the launch tracker under PR/Customer stories. @Sam please add the 2-paragraph case study draft to the shared doc and tag me for final review. :rocket:
Ava: Got it — will attach production notes to the event and include the backup recording instructions.
deploy-bot: Note: marketing-launch-tracker updated: Novablue case study added (owner: Maria)
Maria: Thanks everyone — smooth runway. If legal flags anything during the call, we'll pause and update the draft before publishing.
